source.title: Interaction between Paracetamol Glucuronide and a Glucose-Sensitive Insulin Molecule (NNC2215): Increased Risk of Hypoglycemia — Supporting Information

method_evidence.location: Appendix S2, Molecular dynamics and NMR experiments, SI page S-18
method_evidence.starting_system_description: An in-house crystal structure of a macrocycle similar to the macrocycle in NNC2215 bound to glucose
method_evidence.pag_pose_generation: A representative snapshot from the 500 ns macrocycle–glucose production trajectory was used to generate an initial macrocycle–PaG configuration in Maestro; the PaG complex was then subjected to the same MD protocol.
method_evidence.equilibration_description: The SI refers to a standard equilibration protocol without enumerating its full settings in Appendix S2.

public_record_availability.assessment: The official ACS Figshare item record exposes a single 24-page supporting-information PDF. It does not list the in-house crystal coordinates, Desmond system, trajectory, or extracted snapshot as machine-readable files. This is a finding about the public item checked, not a claim that the authors do not retain those materials.

reproduction_implication: An exact rerun from the cited public item is currently blocked by the missing machine-readable starting structure and trajectory/snapshot files. Any study using the public 2024 NNC2215 models or another macrocycle structure must be labelled and evaluated as a separate proxy study.
